alternatives_rejected.why: Own span self-time stayed flat (0.14->0.1ms) while caller-observed latency rose 19.7x (E2), so slow processing is not the cause. The latency z-score (403) also far outweighs the memory z-score (69.8) (E1).
Frontend latency-90 (z=156) is below currencyservice latency-50 (z=403) (E1). Inbound calls to currencyservice slowed from 5ms to 99ms (E2), so frontend latency is inherited from currencyservice.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove any network delay rule (e.g., tc netem) or service-mesh latency fault on the currencyservice pod's network path. Then confirm that inbound p50 to currencyservice returns to about 5ms. If the rule cannot be found, perform a rolling restart of currencyservice.
